purpose: ANSWER KEY for testing the Phase 2 root-cause engine against the demo fixtures. The roots each demo student was written to have. Never read by the engine or the app; only tests may load this file. Deleted in Phase P with the fixtures.

expected_roots.rationale: Every one of these errors is a missing inner-function derivative. The chain rule is the common prerequisite of implicit, parametric, inverse-trig and exp/log differentiation, substitution and rates of change. It should rank first: most records and most marks.
Phenol acidity, directive influence, amine basicity, haloarene reactivity and carbocation stability all fail by ignoring delocalisation (+R/-R).
Four errors need double/half-angle formulae and one needs product-to-sum; both families derive from compound-angle formulae. trig_compound_angles is acceptable because it covers q25 too.

demo-ananya.expected_pattern: careless_and_notation: no conceptual root should be reported with high confidence; the engine should surface habits (constant of integration, units, final-step checks, sign care, reading the reagent) rather than a concept to re-teach. Two records share the constant-of-integration slip (math.antiderivative_basics.m1), which is a habit, not a gap.

expected_roots.rationale: Three errors are identity errors ((a+b)^2, a^3 - b^3) and two are factorisation failures. Factorisation depends on algebraic identities, so the deepest root explaining all five is a Class 9 concept. factorisation is acceptable but explains only two directly.
